issues.legal_issue: A court in whose territory a cheque is presented for collection, or another component of the cheque-dishonour offence occurs, may have territorial jurisdiction to try the complaint even when the drawee bank is elsewhere.
material_facts: The complainant, who resided and maintained his bank account in Bhiwani, presented the cheque for collection through his bank there.
The cheque was returned unpaid to the complainant through his bank in Bhiwani, and the complaint stated that dishonour occurred there.
The complainant sent the demand notice from Bhiwani and received the drawer’s reply there.
The cheque was drawn on a bank in Guwahati, outside Bhiwani.
issues.conclusion: The Bhiwani court had territorial jurisdiction to try the complaint. The Supreme Court dismissed the appeal and upheld the refusal to interfere under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
issues.legal_principle: Under Sections 177, 178(d) and 179 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, an offence involving acts in different local areas may be tried in a court having jurisdiction over any such area. In K. Bhaskaran v. Sankaran Vaidhyan Balan, the Court held that the offence under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act comprises drawing the cheque, presenting it, its return unpaid, giving written demand notice, and failure to pay within the prescribed period, and that a court where a component occurs may have jurisdiction. Ishar Alloy Steels Ltd. v. Jayaswals Neco Ltd. concerned the statutory time for presenting a cheque to the drawer’s bank, not territorial jurisdiction, and does not displace K. Bhaskaran. Harman Electronics Pvt. Ltd. v. National Panasonic India Pvt. Ltd. establishes that sending a notice from a place alone does not confer jurisdiction; communication of the notice and subsequent non-payment are relevant.

rule.if: cheque_dishonour_complaint and (cheque_drawn_in_forum or cheque_presented_in_forum or cheque_returned_unpaid_in_forum or demand_notice_communicated_in_forum_and_nonpayment_followed or drawer_resides_in_forum or payee_resides_in_forum)

predicates.cheque_dishonour_complaint: A complainant brought a criminal complaint alleging that a cheque was dishonoured and the drawer failed to pay after demand.
predicates.cheque_drawn_in_forum: The cheque was drawn within the territory of the court whose jurisdiction is in issue.
predicates.cheque_presented_in_forum: The cheque was presented for collection within the territory of the court whose jurisdiction is in issue.
predicates.cheque_returned_unpaid_in_forum: The cheque was returned unpaid within the territory of the court whose jurisdiction is in issue.
predicates.demand_notice_communicated_in_forum_and_: The written demand was communicated within the territory of the court, and the drawer thereafter failed to pay within the required period.
predicates.drawer_resides_in_forum: The drawer resided within the territory of the court whose jurisdiction is in issue.
predicates.payee_resides_in_forum: The payee resided within the territory of the court whose jurisdiction is in issue.
predicates.forum_court_has_territorial_jurisdiction: The court in the relevant territory is competent to try the complaint.

issues.definition: When a cheque-dishonour complaint is brought and a listed component of the offence occurs in the court’s territory, or the drawer or payee resides there, that court has territorial jurisdiction.
